facts.big: My… is broken. · Is there a…?
facts.label: Consertar um celular
facts.sub: Explique My phone screen is broken. Pergunte Can you fix it? e How long does it take? Combine o preço e pergunte Is there a warranty?

facts.label: Lojas de conserto
facts.sub: Em muitas cidades americanas, pequenas lojas consertam telas e baterias de celular no mesmo dia. Em geral você deixa o aparelho, espera um pouco e já sai com ele pronto.

facts.label: Garantia
facts.sub: Uma garantia é uma promessa de que, se a peça nova falhar, o conserto será grátis por um tempo. Muitas lojas dão de trinta a noventa dias. Guarde o papel.

pages.title: A broken screen · 1/3
paragraphs: Sara drops her phone on the sidewalk in Phoenix. The black case is fine, but the screen is broken. She walks into a small phone shop nearby. A man named Omar sits behind the counter. He opens the phone with a tiny screwdriver. Sara feels worried because she needs it for work.
“Hi! Can I help you?” says Omar. “My phone screen is broken. Can you fix it?” says Sara. “Let me see. Yes, I can repair it today.” says Omar.

Tap = tocar na tela. Dobra o p: tapped.

items.why: Com she, o verbo leva -s: taps.
Com we, a forma base: squeeze.

solo: Aluno responde; você explica o porquê.

answers: Yesterday I ___. → dropped
She ___ every day. → taps
He is ___ now. → scratching
We ___ every day. → squeeze
